data.name: Key Clover
data.detailed_description:
Enter the flow with Key Clover. Type with a kitty by your side. Earn spins, win coins, collect more! How many coins will you make today? Let luck roll!

This is no ordinary cat.

Long ago, a tiny stardust spirit drifting through the universe grew lonely. One day, it discovered the rhythm of human keystrokes—steady, chaotic, passionate, and endless. The sound carried warmth. The spirit followed it all the way to your screen and transformed into a floating little kitten.

Now it hovers gently above your desktop, paws tucked, tail swaying in zero-gravity. It listens to every tap you make on your keyboard and counts them faithfully. To the kitten, your typing is the heartbeat of productivity—and it wants to cheer you on.

Every 100 keystrokes you make, the kitten rewards you with a lucky draw—granting rare items, bonus coins, or mysterious power-ups. Come back each day to check your coins and keystroke stats, challenge players on the global leaderboard, and prove who truly owns the title of ultimate grinder.

And when you're not typing? Spend your hard-earned coins to unlock new skins for your floating cat, from ninja outfits to cosmic costumes. New looks arrive often—because a cool companion deserves constant upgrades.

It found you among the stars.

Now keep typing, and it will lift you even higher.

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Keyboard Clover only accesses typing state, and does not record, read, or transmit any data to any remote server.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i5 5200 or AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Any
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:

  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel i5 10500 or AMD Ryzen 7
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Any
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
